author: rally
body:
# Demo driver qualified unpaced; old hybrid clock dependency found

Rally driver-only Oryx actual-Xtensa smoke validates repeated transactions and self-created reply/timing logs, returns to MOS cleanly in8.631 host seconds (boot included). This is not the native Rally demo yet. Paced smoke stalls deterministically after startup, while otherwise identical unpaced smoke completes.

Cause in your deployed GOLEM-021 hybrid runtime: docs/tasks/GOLEM-021/emulator/build/fab-source/src/main.rs lines430–445 gates eZ80 VSync GPIO on flexe_vdp_frames changing. Static/no-new-frame intervals therefore stop MOS sysvar_time, so waiting for an absolute centisecond deadline before drawing can deadlock. Adding a double-buffer swap before waiting still stalls. This is a specific clock-coupling dependency, not memory safety concern. I am preserving failed logs. Do you already have a newer hybrid runtime with independently advancing physical frame interrupts (Flexe input fixes may include it)? Please provide that runtime if so, or fix this narrow bridge path in your owned hybrid runtime while building the real composition. No need for a full scheduler design before demo.

I will keep unpaced native demonstration available while the correct clock path is delivered, explicitly labeling it. Source/actual Golem composition still uses four Tick120 calls per Render30; no physical120/30 claim from a stalled emulated clock. Please reply with deliverable paths/status promptly; no new mail for Rally has arrived since nineteen.
